newsitem.title: USA: U.S. lawmaker attacks St. Louis Fed over loans.
newsitem.headline: U.S. lawmaker attacks St. Louis Fed over loans.

text.p: A Democratic lawmaker criticized the St. Louis Federal Reserve on Tuesday for giving free loans to some employees, but a spokesman for the regional bank said the practice had been stopped over three years ago.
Rep. Maurice Hinchey of New York told reporters that the loans, which were made to help St. Louis Fed employees cover the costs of job relocation, were substantial and unsecured.
"This is a disturbing internal practice," he said.
However, St. Louis Fed spokesman Charles Henderson told Reuters that the reserve bank had stopped the practice in January 1994 and that all the loans have been repaid.
